limits: Raw stdout/stderr, fixtures, binaries, runtimes, checkout/build/cache trees and authentication helpers are excluded.
Failed bundle preparation is represented by exact indices/failure receipts/helper versions; unchanged numerical payloads are included once in final bundles.
Fixture-path JSON provenance has byte-identical safe metadata aliases with original identities.
Scoped patch is byte-exact UTF8 in JSON with its original raw hash.
